caption: The drawing depicts a square textile design with a patterned border and a central area featuring floral motifs. The border is decorated with a repeating pattern of red and pink flowers with green leaves, placed on a white background bordered by a green, scalloped edge. In the central area, there are two prominent blue vases with ribbed textures, each holding an arrangement of multicolored flowers with shades of red, pink, yellow, purple, and blue along with green foliage. Some parts of the floral and vase designs are fully colored, while others are lightly sketched, showing outlines without color. The background is filled with diagonal quilted lines that create a textured effect. The overall composition of the drawing integrates both finished and unfinished sections, showcasing detailed elements on a neutral, off-white background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
